setup.text: A villager wonders whether other islands hold people like them or entirely different civilizations.

choices.label: Prepare a welcoming code for hypothetical visitors.
Teach that differences need not mean danger.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The catalogue gains clues but no proof of distant societies.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: A strange carved bead raises more questions than answers.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: The council agrees on respect, consent, and resource boundaries.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: Children imagine both shared customs and unfamiliar ones.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: An elder reminds them that curiosity should include caution.
